headlines.summary_en: On July 23, Meng Huating, Director of the Foreign Investment Administration Department of the Ministry of Commerce, said at a press conference that the Ministry of Commerce will implement the catalog of encouraged industries for foreign investment, guiding foreign investment into advanced manufacturing such as organic polymer materials and high-efficiency energy-saving maglev power equipment, modern services such as humanoid robot R&D and modern high-end shipping services, and encouraging more foreign investment in central, western, and northeastern regions.

headlines.summary: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅23日上午在马尼拉会见埃及外长阿卜杜勒阿提。王毅表示，中方愿同埃方一道，密切高层交往，深化经贸、军事、人工智能等领域合作，加强多边事务协作，共同构建面向新时代的中埃命运共同体。在埃方支持下，米娜宫饭店建立《开罗宣言》纪念碑，具有重要纪念意义，也体现了埃方尊重历史、弘扬正义、重视对华关系的积极态度。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi meets with Egyptian Foreign Minister Abdelatty
headlines.summary_en: Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, met with Egyptian Foreign Minister Abdel Aty in Manila on the morning of the 23rd. Wang Yi said that China is willing to work with Egypt to maintain close high-level exchanges, deepen cooperation in trade, military, artificial intelligence, and other fields, strengthen multilateral coordination, and jointly build a China-Egypt community with a shared future for the new era. With Egyptian support, the establishment of the 'Cairo Declaration' monument at the Mena House Hotel holds significant commemorative value and reflects Egypt's respect for history, promotion of justice, and positive attitude toward China relations. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 商务部：将加快修订出台关于外国投资者并购境内企业的规定
headlines.summary: 商务部外国投资管理司司长孟华婷在新闻发布会上表示，下半年，将继续围绕利用外资固稳促优目标，进一步塑造吸引外资新优势，做好扩增量、稳存量、提质量各项工作。在扩增量方面，将继续实施高水平对外开放，稳妥有序深化增值电信、生物技术、外商独资医院和职业技能培训机构等领域的开放试点，支持北京市提升国家服务业综合示范区建设水平，还将加快修订出台关于外国投资者并购境内企业的规定。将持续打造“投资中国”品牌，精心设计一系列投资促进活动。中国国际投资贸易洽谈会是“投资中国”的标志性展会，今年将举办第26届，欢迎跨国公司积极参展参会。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Will accelerate revision and issuance of regulations on foreign investors' M&A of domestic enterprises
headlines.summary_en: Meng Huating, Director of the Foreign Investment Administration Department of the Ministry of Commerce, said at a press conference that in the second half of the year, the focus will continue to be on stabilizing and optimizing foreign capital utilization, creating new advantages for attracting foreign investment, and working on expanding increment, maintaining stock, and improving quality. For expanding increment, China will continue to implement high-level opening-up, cautiously and orderly deepen pilot openings in fields such as value-added telecom, biotechnology, wholly foreign-owned hospitals, and vocational training institutions, support Beijing in improving the construction level of the National Comprehensive Service Industry Demonstration Zone, and accelerate the revision and issuance of regulations on foreign investors' acquisition of domestic enterprises. It will continue to build the 'Invest in China' brand and carefully design investment promotion activities. The China International Fair for Investment & Trade is a flagship event for 'Invest in China', and this year will be the 26th edition, welcoming multinational companies to actively participate. (Securities Times)

headlines.summary:
Shanghai’s economy expanded 5.6 per cent in the first half of the year, beating expectations on strong growth in hi-tech manufacturing and exports, even as weak consumer spending exposed the uneven nature of the recovery.
According to data released by the municipal statistics bureau on Monday, the reading surpassed both the national growth rate of 4.7 per cent for the same period and the city’s own growth rates in recent years, signalling a resilient rebound in the financial and commercial...

headlines.title_en: Beijing: Encourages development of token economy, increases support like computing vouchers
headlines.summary_en: The Beijing Municipal Development and Reform Commission and other departments jointly issued 'Several Measures for Accelerating the Leading Development of Intelligent Agents in Beijing' to promote innovative development of intelligent agents and take the lead in cultivating new forms of intelligent economy. The Token economy is encouraged. Innovation entities are encouraged to develop general-purpose processors adapted to intelligent agent system calls, complex task scheduling, and high-frequency decision-making, and to develop low-latency, high-throughput dedicated inference chips. They are also encouraged to tackle key technologies like inference architecture, reduce inference costs through heterogeneous coordination, storage-computation collaboration, and intelligent scheduling, and accelerate efficiency optimization at the application layer such as inference cache reuse and intelligent task routing, to optimize Token efficiency across the entire chain.

headlines.title_en: A-share market close: Three major indexes edge up, grid equipment sector surges
headlines.summary_en: The market fluctuated sideways throughout the day, with the three major indices slightly higher. The power grid equipment sector surged, with over 20 stocks including Zhongneng Electric, Shuangjie Electric, and Heshun Electric hitting daily limits. The military sector rallied in the afternoon, with Hunan Tianyan, Great Wall Military, and Beizhi Tech hitting daily limits. The oil and gas sector continued its strength, with Zhongman Petroleum rising in 4 days for 3 limits and Bomai Technology hitting a daily limit. On the downside, semiconductor chip stocks adjusted, with Huahong Hongli and Yandong Micro falling over 10%. More stocks rose than fell, with over 4,200 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets turning red, and today's turnover nearly 2.21 trillion yuan. At the close, the Shanghai Composite index rose 0.25%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 0.44%, and the ChiNext Index rose 0.25%.

headlines.title: 大行评级｜大摩：大幅下调滔搏目标价至1.67港元，评级降至“与大市同步”
headlines.summary: 摩根士丹利发表研报指，Nike收回在线分销权对零售伙伴构成重大不确定性。滔搏作为Nike在中国最大的单品牌门店运营商，受到的影响最大，其在2026财年(今年2月底止)有22%的收入来自Nike在线平台销售。该行将滔搏2027至2029财年的每股盈利预测分别下调20%、44%及38%，并预计2027及2028财年的收入均同比下降14%，净利润均同比下降21%。大摩将滔搏的估值基准延伸至2028财年预测，目标市盈率由15倍下调至11倍，将其目标价由3.6港元大幅下调至1.67港元，评级亦由“增持”降至“与大市同步”。

headlines.title_en: Major rating | Morgan Stanley: Sharply cuts Top Sports target price to HK$1.67, downgrades to 'Market Perform'
headlines.summary_en: Morgan Stanley released a research report stating that Nike's move to reclaim online distribution rights poses significant uncertainty for retail partners. Top Sports, as Nike's largest single-brand store operator in China, is most affected, with 22% of its revenue in fiscal year 2026 (ending February this year) coming from Nike's online platform sales. The firm cut its EPS forecasts for Top Sports for fiscal years 2027 to 2029 by 20%, 44%, and 38% respectively, and expects revenues in fiscal years 2027 and 2028 to both fall 14% year-on-year, with net profits both down 21% year-on-year. Morgan Stanley extended its valuation base for Top Sports to fiscal 2028 forecasts, cutting the target P/E from 15x to 11x, sharply lowering the target price from HKD 3.6 to HKD 1.67, and downgrading the rating from 'Overweight' to 'Equal-weight'.

headlines.title: 国务院：进一步加强群众身边健身场地设施建设
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月23日讯，《全民健身计划（2026—2030年）》指出，将全民健身场地设施建设纳入地方国土空间规划。推动群众身边的场地设施布局建设与常住人口总量、结构、流动趋势相衔接，新增资源优先向人口密集、供需矛盾突出的区域倾斜。实施群众运动空间扩容计划，充分利用城市“金角银边”，盘活利用工业厂房、仓储用房、商业用房、高架桥下、建筑屋顶等存量空间，因地制宜打造全龄友好健身空间，建设更多群众身边“小而美”的全民健身场地设施。新建或改扩建一批小（微）型体育公园、小型健身中心、多功能运动场、小型足球场地、群众滑冰场等场地设施，增加球类、冰雪等运动人口增长较快项目

headlines.title_en: State Council: Further strengthen construction of fitness facilities near communities
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, July 23 - The 'National Fitness Plan (2026-2030)' states that the construction of national fitness facilities will be included in local territorial spatial planning. The layout of fitness facilities near the public will be coordinated with the total, structure, and mobility trends of the permanent population, with new resources prioritized for densely populated areas with prominent supply-demand imbalances. An expansion plan for public sports space will be implemented, fully utilizing urban 'golden corners and silver edges', revitalizing existing spaces such as industrial plants, storage rooms, commercial properties, under-viaduct areas, and building rooftops, to create age-friendly fitness spaces tailored to local conditions and build more 'small yet beautiful' national fitness facilities for the public. New or renovated small (micro) sports parks, small fitness centers, multi-purpose sports fields, small football fields, and public skating rinks will be built to add sports populations for ball games and ice-snow sports showing faster growth.

headlines.title: 商务部：中美双方经贸团队正在探讨推进各自300亿美元规模的对等降税的框架安排
headlines.summary: 商务部外资司司长孟华婷在23日举行的国新办新闻发布会上回应中美双方成立贸易理事会、投资理事会进展的有关提问时说，目前，中美双方经贸团队正在就贸易理事会架构、职能、运行模式等具体安排保持密切沟通，并探讨推进各自300亿美元规模的对等降税框架安排。中方正在就相关降税安排建议广泛征求国内企业、商协会、地方政府、美资企业商协会等利益相关方意见，美方也在就贸易理事会及对等降税安排征求公众评论意见。双方将保持密切交流，尽快商定具体产品降税安排并推动实施，进一步拓展双边贸易。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Sino-US trade teams discussing framework for reciprocal tariff cuts on $30 billion each
headlines.summary_en: Meng Huating, Director of the Foreign Investment Administration Department of the Ministry of Commerce, responded at a press conference on the 23rd to questions about progress on the establishment of trade councils and investment councils between China and the US. He said that currently, economic and trade teams from both sides are maintaining close communication on specific arrangements such as the council's structure, functions, and operating model, and are exploring the advancement of a framework arrangement for reciprocal tariff reduction of around USD 30 billion each. China is widely soliciting opinions from domestic enterprises, trade associations, local governments, and US-invested business associations on the proposed tariff reduction arrangements, while the US is also seeking public comment on the trade council and reciprocal tariff reduction. Both sides will maintain close exchanges, finalize specific product tariff reduction arrangements as soon as possible, and promote implementation to further expand bilateral trade. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 商务部：将加快培育服务消费新增长点
headlines.summary: 7月23日，商务部副部长鄢东在国新办新闻发布会上表示，近期商务部会同有关部门出台了铁旅融合、家政高质量发展、培育壮大汽车后市场等服务消费新增长点政策文件，商务部将抓好贯彻落实。同时，还将围绕交通、演出、赛事等细分领域，进一步创新支持举措，鼓励地方积极培育服务消费新增长点的有效路径。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Will accelerate cultivation of new growth points for service consumption
headlines.summary_en: On July 23, Yan Dong, Vice Minister of Commerce, said at a press conference that the Ministry of Commerce recently, together with relevant departments, issued policy documents on service consumption new growth points such as railway-tourism integration, high-quality development of household services, and fostering the growth of the auto aftermarket. The Ministry of Commerce will ensure effective implementation. At the same time, it will further innovate support measures in sub-sectors such as transportation, performances, and events, encouraging local authorities to actively cultivate effective paths for new growth points in service consumption.

headlines.title: 上半年近4800家外资企业追加对华投资
headlines.summary: 商务部副部长鄢东在23日举行的国新办发布会上说，上半年我国新设外资企业数同比增长5.3%，引资额4021.4亿元。引资结构进一步优化，高技术产业引资同比增长33.2%，占比提升至42.4%。外资持续看好中国市场，上半年近4800家外资企业追加对华投资。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Nearly 4,800 foreign-invested enterprises increased investments in China in H1
headlines.summary_en: Vice Minister of Commerce Yan Dong said at a press conference on the 23rd that in the first half of the year, the number of newly established foreign-funded enterprises in China increased by 5.3% year-on-year, with attracted investment reaching 402.14 billion yuan. The structure of attracted investment further improved, with high-tech industry investment up 33.2% year-on-year, accounting for 42.4%. Foreign capital continues to be optimistic about the Chinese market, with nearly 4,800 foreign-funded enterprises increasing their investment in China in the first half. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 台积电供应商李长荣称KKR拟退出 加速扩张计划将少一重阻碍
headlines.summary: 李长荣集团总裁表示，私募股权巨头KKR & Co.计划逐步出售其所持该公司旗下业务的股份，将有利于这家家族控股的中国台湾化工企业加速扩大其半导体材料业务。KKR持有包括李长荣化学工业及一家关联公司的股份。李谋伟在接受采访时拒绝透露KKR份额的可能买家。（彭博）

headlines.title_en: TSMC supplier Lee Chang Yung says KKR plans to exit, removing a hurdle for accelerated expansion
headlines.summary_en: The president of LCY Group said that private equity giant KKR & Co.'s plan to gradually sell its stake in the company's business will help this family-controlled Taiwan chemical firm accelerate its expansion into the semiconductor materials sector. KKR holds stakes in LCY Chemical and an affiliated company. Li Mouwei declined to reveal potential buyers for KKR's stake in an interview. (Bloomberg)

headlines.title: 商务部：上半年外资企业、国有企业进出口均实现两位数增长
headlines.summary: 今天（7月23日）下午，国务院新闻办公室举行新闻发布会，介绍2026年上半年商务工作及运行情况。相关负责人介绍，上半年民营企业贡献近六成外贸增量，外资企业、国有企业进出口均实现了两位数增长。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Imports and exports of foreign-invested and state-owned enterprises both achieved double-digit growth in H1
headlines.summary_en: This afternoon (July 23), the State Council Information Office held a press conference to report on the business operations and performance in the first half of 2026. The responsible official stated that in the first half, private enterprises contributed nearly 60% of foreign trade growth, while imports and exports of both foreign-invested enterprises and state-owned enterprises achieved double-digit growth. (CCTV News)
